name: node-dashboard
description: A minimal Vite-style Node dashboard scaffold with frontend source layout, Docker support, and Jenkins pipeline support.
recommended_use: Use for frontend dashboards, internal admin panels, portfolio UI demos, and lightweight service dashboards that can pair with Java or Python backend services.
smoke_test_command: test -f package.json && test -f index.html && test -f src/App.jsx && grep -q 'Forge Generated Dashboard' src/App.jsx && grep -q 'vite' package.json
